text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow! Is this present for me? You're<n>the best!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Don't get your hopes up too high. I<n>don't have a
great eye for these<n>kinds of things.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Awww, hearing that only makes me<n>more curious...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? This wrapping paper...<n>Isn't it from that
sporting goods<n>shop?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...It's a hammer for your cleats.<n>Weren't you
thinking about buying a<n>new one recently?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I tell you to not get too<n>excited? ...If you're
not going to use<n>it, I will.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I'll use it, I'll use it! Sorry, you<n>just surprised
me, that's all!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Ayabe, you don't need to put<n>yourself down like
that, 'kay? I'm<n>actually kinda jealous of how
considerate you are!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And thanks again for the present! I'll<n>take real good
care of it. ♪
